faqs.a:
(a)
Service of process
for a violation of this division shall be initiated as set forth in
section 58-4
of this Code.
(b)
Presumption in reference to illegal parking.
For purposes of this division only, it shall be presumed that the person who parked
               the vehicle was the registered owner of the vehicle, or that the vehicle was parked
               with the registered owner's knowledge and permission.
(c)
Violations applied whether vehicle occupied or not.
A violation of any provision of this division may occur whether a vehicle is occupied
               or not.
(d)
Violations not exclusive.
The provisions of this division imposing limitations, restrictions, and prohibitions
               on parking shall not relieve any person from the duty to observe other more restrictive
               provisions limiting, restricting, or prohibiting the stopping, standing, or parking
               of a vehicle in a specified place, at a specified time, or in a specified manner.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
